newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Latam, Caribbean coffee coops to form group soon.
newsitem.headline: Latam, Caribbean coffee coops to form group soon.

text.p: Officials from cooperative organizations from 11 Latin American and Caribbean coffee producing countries are expected to meet in the coming month to formalize a new association, a Brazilian official said.

The idea of an association to promote the exchange of information arose at a recent meeting in Honduras and Costa Rica of officials from cooperative organisations, said Dejandir dal Pasquale, president of the Brazilian Cooperatives Organisation.
"At the meeting the creation of the Association of Cooperatives of Coffee Producing Countries was proposed," dal Pasquale said.
"We are awaiting the official response of Colombia and Ecuador who said they were favorable but wanted to speak to their leaders," he added.
The association would join cooperatives from coffee producing countries in the Caribbean, Central and South America and its official creation is expected within the next 15 to 20 days, he added.
The association would "only coordinate" contacts between members, dal Pasquale said.

Initially the association would help in the exchange of technical information. It may also look at possible cooperation on the commercial side but as yet there had been no discussions as to how this would work, he added. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
